text: The Transportation Working Group, Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee would like to ensure that construction sites that are blocking public access remain accessible to people with disabilities and that the regulations are enforced to ensure this.

The Executive Committee: 1. Requested the General Manager, Transportation Services to make a presentation to the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee in the first quarter of 2018 on the regulations for construction sites on public spaces to ensure accessibility around obstructions present in constructions areas, including regulations for construction on Toronto Transit Commission property.
